about: Leftover classes of tools/bench/triage.py, first match wins in this order. A class matches a block by its end ("ends": the bench report's run end, or its first word, so `killed` matches `killed (no exit status)`) or a leftover by "regex" (Python re.search, DOTALL) on the leftover head: `pure <conclusion>` for an exported pure goal (its conclusion as ResidualExport prints it, every application in `@f args` form), `spatial <goal skeleton>` or `spatial-call <goal skeleton>` for a spatial goal (skeleton of the last step before it, spaces printed as `_`; -call when the caller's premises include a callee spec), `error <first error line>` for a failed block with no export. "max_bytes" bounds the exported statement's size. REFUSED and BLOCKED have neither: triage.py --render gives them to the callers a render refused. Plan step 1.4, issue #316.

classes.next_action: stepping-only probe (tools/block/probe_mirror.py); shrink the statement before any tactic work
killed at the memory limit, no goal printed: measure the statement (successor binders, join guard size), then a stepping-only probe (tools/block/probe_mirror.py) under the same limit
the render refused the block's own entry; the sub-class is the refusal kind of render/RESULT.json, the head its detail
caller not rendered: a successor entry or the function-return package was refused (head: which, and its refusal); fix that refusal first
guard view: derive the boolean guard from its Prop branch fact (check that fact is visible at the block)
binder map of the edge; never a prover
check the visible call facts of 1.2-4
print the address and the resources
a needed fact is hidden: add it to the visible list
one spelling of the little-endian word (rule 1.1d-1)
one spelling of the word read from the call result (1.1d-1), then the order facts of the payload window (1.1e-2)
frame window order goal: print the window facts; the ranges of 1.1b-1 in a cleared context
memcpy domain from the function's well-formed arguments (step 2.3: parentHeaderMemcpyDomain, Contracts/ParentHeaderMemcpyService.v)
print the goal at the leftover; join or loop-class successor: binder map of the edge; loop entry: index witness 0 (step 2.3); return join: meaning conjunct (step 2.4)
falsity check on concrete values first; then a sonic agent with the goal and exact lemma names; then a task agent
step 2.2 or 2.4 (a return join's `∃ result, …ResultBytes result = …` is the function's meaning, not a witness)
